registration_phase: before any oracle, solver warmup or timed call

design.inputs: 30 ordered inputs:18 independent random trees;4 constructed unordered semantics each with best-first/late-improvement representations;4 special inputs
design.construction: positional base-b leaf digits construct first-best ordering; no oracle-based runtime reorder or free true-value lookahead
design.scope: full finite tree, no truncation/iterative deepening/transposition table; finite int/float leaves
design.primary: Scout minus same-module AB complete time and all TEST+EVAL leaf reads, paired on same tree/order/block
design.secondary: original AB practical baseline; instrumentation and implementation differ
design.random_order: fixed per-node permutation rebuilt within every timed call and included in total preparation cost
design.timing: serial; one discarded warmup per configuration; shuffled case/order tasks and shuffled methods per block; default GC
design.included: order preparation, all TEST/EVAL visits, counters and all re-searches; output format conversion outside timer for all methods
design.excluded: tree construction, structural validation, independent minimax oracle, diagnostics, trace, serialization and charts
design.units: 7 repeated blocks do not add independent trees; paired IQR is descriptive, not a confidence interval
design.honest_results: no performance-based input filtering; retain every loss and non-beneficial case
